stories.h: Everett launches $7M fund against light-rail displacement
stories.s: The South Everett Futures Fund, run by LISC Puget Sound, aims over 10 years to protect 1,000 homes, build 1,250 affordable ones and support 100 businesses near future light rail stations.

stories.h: Jury convicts man in 2022 Everett apartment killing
stories.s: A 31-year-old was convicted of aggravated first-degree murder for shooting a 22-year-old as he slept, a conviction that carries life. Sentencing is Dec. 11.

stories.h: Sen. Marko Liias enters 2027 county executive race
stories.s: Liias will run to succeed term-limited Dave Somers, who endorsed him. Council member Jared Mead joined the race two days earlier.

stories.h: Arlington police chief placed on leave, set to retire
stories.s: Chief Jonathan Ventura went on administrative leave Nov. 18 with a tentative 2027 retirement date. The city says it isn't disciplinary; Cmdr. Mike Gilbert is acting chief.

stories.h: Mill Creek annexation draws 200-plus to town hall
stories.s: Annexation would bring about 11,700 county residents into Mill Creek by 2028, lowering property taxes but adding a utility tax. The council decides in December how to proceed.

coming.h: Thanksgiving travel crunch on highways and ferries
coming.s: WSDOT's holiday travel charts cover Nov. 25–29; ferries busiest westbound Nov. 25–26 and eastbound Nov. 28–29.
Kickoff runs 2–8 p.m. at Colby and Hewitt avenues; Santa lights the tree just after 5 p.m.
